## Activity

During October 2021, North City Eye Clinic completed 439 captures. Activity proceeded in line with the site’s planned operations. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that the clinic maintained its scheduled capture service throughout the month, with no other operational exception identified in the report.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally satisfactory. Graders marked 9 sets as ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 2.1 of all captures. These cases should continue to be reviewed through routine feedback and quality assurance processes so that recurring issues can be identified and addressed. The result provides a basis for monitoring image quality in subsequent reporting periods.

## Grading

Grading identified 99 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 4. This indicates that grading activity was completed within the expected operational workflow recorded for the site. The referable findings and the ungradable cases should remain subject to the clinic’s established review and follow-up arrangements. Overall, the report records continued service activity, a low level of ungradable images, and completion of grading for the month.
